claims.claim: Both response transports normalize to ordered generation-local row/path/body values with bounded framing and terminal reconciliation
claims.limit: Executable invariants and tests; no formal proof, transaction over external callback effects or time bound.

claims.claim: Existing pipe protocol exposes OPEN with expected native revision, PIN alias, RUNPIN alias and UNPIN
claims.limit: PIN returns revision only; RUN has no expected-generation argument. Proposed controller must bind OPEN generation to matching PIN revision.

claims.claim: Retained Worker and result components have explicit bounds; default JSONL remains compatible
claims.limit: Named retained components, not process memory, inference memory or native Windows validation.

claims.claim: Release and sanitizer builds each passed 10 gates; final framing suite 26 tests; producer 22 tests

claims.claim: Portable standard-library audit verifies retained sources, original-body descriptors, recorded policy/traffic/timing arithmetic

claims.claim: Optimize tool machinery while keeping the same declared completed observation
claims.limit: Proposed research framing and semantic contract; not a novel general theorem.
